incident_text: Part of a five-storey apartment building has collapsed. Dust covers the street and neighbours say some residents may still be inside.

result.scene_summary: A destroyed multi-story building with collapsed walls and debris scattered on the ground, surrounded by other damaged structures and vegetation.

observations.description: A multi-story building with significant structural damage, collapsed sections, exposed interiors, and debris on the ground.
A tall, partially collapsed building with visible windows, balconies, and exposed beams.
A green tree visible in the background and some vegetation among the debris.
Debris including broken bricks, wood, metal sheets, and a white sack in the foreground.
